description: This file implements the HeartbeatProcedure class and related classes for handling heartbeat signals in the firebolt::rialto::server namespace. It includes factory methods, a heartbeat handler, and logic for starting and finishing heartbeat pings.

classes.name: firebolt::rialto::server::HeartbeatProcedure
classes.description: Main class managing heartbeat procedures, including creation of handlers, tracking pings sent, and finalizing procedures.

classes.name: firebolt::rialto::server::HeartbeatProcedure::HeartbeatHandler
classes.description: Nested class handling individual heartbeat ping lifecycle events such as ping sent, error, and completion.

methods.name: firebolt::rialto::server::IHeartbeatProcedureFactory::createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a new factory instance for heartbeat procedures.

methods.name: firebolt::rialto::server::HeartbeatProcedureFactory::createHeartbeatProcedure
methods.description: Creates a new HeartbeatProcedure instance with specified ackSender and pingId.

methods.name: firebolt::rialto::server::HeartbeatProcedure::createHandler
methods.description: Creates a new HeartbeatHandler for managing a specific heartbeat ping.

methods.name: firebolt::rialto::server::HeartbeatProcedure::onStart
methods.description: Marks the start of a heartbeat ping for a given controlId.

methods.name: firebolt::rialto::server::HeartbeatProcedure::onFinish
methods.description: Marks the end of a heartbeat ping, updating success status.

methods.name: firebolt::rialto::server::HeartbeatProcedure::HeartbeatHandler::pingSent
methods.description: Indicates that a ping has been sent.

methods.name: firebolt::rialto::server::HeartbeatProcedure::HeartbeatHandler::error
methods.description: Marks the current heartbeat as failed.

methods.name: firebolt::rialto::server::HeartbeatProcedure::HeartbeatHandler::id
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the current ping.
